purpose: Give every point of the electrode-count curve ten seeds, to tell a peak at 16 electrodes from seed noise
selection: All nine participants; first k electrodes of the archived session-1 relevance order; no new selection and no change to the historical final configuration
primary: artifact-free session-2 trials; average seeds within participant, then the nine participants
claim_boundary: Exploratory. Planned after the historical test results and the first-wave results were known. Describes the curve; not a basis for choosing an electrode count.
